answer: Sybil rings hide wallets behind one network, so a verifier named PrefixCap counts identities per routable prefix and admits two per /24 per epoch. The penalty trigger is prefix quarantine: a third account freezes every bond under that prefix and forfeits the range rent, forcing a farm to rent separate ranges. Each fake needs its own leased /24 at forty dollars monthly, a thirty POA bond and ten minutes of setup, so N fakes cost N times seventy dollars, and a wander through cheap hosting stops paying while a bridge of proxies only bills more. The cedar post is the bond, locked ten epochs.
